name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v532: Fixed TV failures. Saved cookies are now validated with a real request instead of trusted by age, so a revoked-but-recent cf_clearance can no longer leave the app with 'Saved' cookies that scrape nothing: app-open and playback probes only skip after a challenge-free response (2-minute trust window). Invisible solve now attaches a real-sized WebView behind the app content instead of a 1x1 GONE view, so Chromium actually renders the challenge on Android TV; it also saves the cookie under every AnimePahe host and purges www variants. If the invisible solve still fails (interactive TV checkbox), it falls back to the visible sheet instead of silently doing nothing. All v531 features retained: no buttons in the normal flow, invisible mode default, per-request UA consistency, probe throttle, stream-link cache.
